overridableConfigKeys.label: Bottom panel button
overridableConfigKeys.description: On a narrow screen, the top-bar button that opens the bottom panel.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Bottom panel
overridableConfigKeys.description: Trait rendered in the bottom panel when showBottomPanel is on.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Floating strip
overridableConfigKeys.description: Trait rendered in the floating strip when showFloating is on.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Main area
overridableConfigKeys.description: Trait rendered in the centre of the workspace (the editor, canvas or preview).
overridableConfigKeys.synonyms: editor area, canvas, centre panel, main panel

overridableConfigKeys.label: Rail
overridableConfigKeys.description: Trait rendered in the far-left rail when showRail is on.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Right sidebar button
overridableConfigKeys.description: On a narrow screen, the top-bar button that opens the right sidebar.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Right sidebar
overridableConfigKeys.description: Trait rendered in the right sidebar when showSecondarySidebar is on.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Right sidebar width
overridableConfigKeys.description: Width of the right sidebar in pixels.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Show a bottom panel?
overridableConfigKeys.description: A collapsible panel under the main area (problems, output, terminal).
overridableConfigKeys.synonyms: bottom drawer, output panel, problems panel, terminal

overridableConfigKeys.label: Show a floating strip over the main area?
overridableConfigKeys.description: A strip centred at the top of the main area, over its content (a toolbar or a status pill).
overridableConfigKeys.synonyms: floating toolbar, top bar over canvas, overlay strip

overridableConfigKeys.label: Show an activity rail?
overridableConfigKeys.description: A narrow far-left strip, usually an icon bar that switches the sidebar's view.
overridableConfigKeys.synonyms: activity bar, icon rail, nav rail

overridableConfigKeys.label: Show a right sidebar?
overridableConfigKeys.description: A collapsible right sidebar (an inspector or a chat).

overridableConfigKeys.label: Show the left sidebar?
overridableConfigKeys.description: The collapsible, resizable left sidebar (an explorer, page list or chat).

overridableConfigKeys.label: Show a status bar?
overridableConfigKeys.description: A slim strip pinned to the bottom of the frame.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Show a top bar above the workspace?
overridableConfigKeys.description: A full-width strip above every region (the project name, view toggles and actions).
overridableConfigKeys.synonyms: workspace header, toolbar strip, top strip

overridableConfigKeys.label: Narrowest left sidebar
overridableConfigKeys.description: Minimum width of the left sidebar in pixels.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Left sidebar
overridableConfigKeys.description: Trait rendered in the left sidebar when showSidebar is on.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Status bar
overridableConfigKeys.description: Trait rendered in the status bar when showStatusBar is on.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Top bar
overridableConfigKeys.description: Trait rendered in the top bar when showTopBar is on.
